svg.aria-label: OpenGrid base server and local dev stack deployment layout
svg.title: OpenGrid base server and local dev stack deployment layout
svg.text: Base server (basepower) from deploy/ · local dev stack from dev/docker-compose.yml · env-variable NAMES only, no secret values
deploy/README.md, deploy/RUNBOOK.md, deploy/systemd/*, deploy/apache/opengrid.conf. No sudo on this host; deploy role only, over SSH.
Location /og/ → http://127.0.0.1:8080 (og-api) · Basic Auth: operator, viewer · SSE-friendly (no buffering/gzip)
AuthUserFile /etc/opengrid/htpasswd (mode 750 root:opengrid; www-data granted search-only via a POSIX ACL, deploy/README.md)
127.0.0.1:5432 · databases: og (prod), og_test, og_t_<ws> (agent workspaces, disposable)
Nightly pg_dump → /srv/ogbackup (NEW, own LV; override OG_BACKUP_DIR), 7 kept, backup.sh
Client ids: <prefix>-<OG_WS>-<process> (NEW, hardened); users og_engine, og_guardian,
og_safestop, og_sim, og_simctl, og_api. Topic root og/v1 (prod, needs OGSIM_ENV=prod, NEW)
og-sim-customer (D-11, IN PROGRESS): unit installed but not enabled (deploy/RUNBOOK.md) — integration-sims/src/ogsim/customer has 0 files on this checkout (grep). Not drawn as a live unit.
Every unit above also sets: Restart=always, RestartSec=2, NoNewPrivileges=true, ProtectSystem=strict,
Local dev stack — dev/docker-compose.yml (“make dev-up”, WP D0)
Mirrors the base server's topology at laptop scale. Status: UNTESTED ON DOCKER (dev/README.md).
og-api (profiles: ["orchestrator"]) — NOT started by default; the normal path runs them from an IDE/venv
against dev/config/dev.toml, whose [feeds.*] base_url already points at sim-market (same config swap as prod)
dev/README.md · dev/docker-compose.yml · dev/.env.example · dev/mosquitto/{opengrid.acl,provision_ws_users.py} (NEW) · engine/metrics.py · BUILD.md (192.168.5.35, permanent host D-16)

Snapshot 434d230 (2026-09-26): og-api/og-sim-{fleet,control,scada} units gained env vars (api_proxy.env, OGSIM_ENV=prod); backup.sh moved to /srv/ogbackup; RUNBOOK.md and provision_ws_users.py are NEW.
